summary: The Klaviyo CLI is reprinted on Printing Press 4.35.4 against Klaviyo API revision 2026-10-15, and every hand-written command and earlier patch is carried onto the new framework in klaviyo_*.go files so later regen-merges classify them as hand-written.
reason: Revision 2026-10-15 adds 128 endpoints (billing usage, brand kit, campaign audiences and variations, flow actions, form publishing, template preview sends) that the 2026-04-15 print could not call; regen-merge alone could not cross a 3.5.0 to 4.35.4 framework jump because generated helpers changed signature.
validated_outcome: Full go build, go vet and go test pass; the fresh template's tracking_settings index survived a column drop and was repaired in the store migration; the reprinted binary keeps every published command path except six reads the generator now nests one level deeper (for example flow-messages template get-for-flow-message).
